params._comment: CUT-INTRO reshoot: tight-to-crane keel-over. Opens IN the watcher's eyes (seamless possession), settles into a tight over-the-shoulder wheel shot (~4 blocks, dutch -2), then cranes up and back as the keel-over begins — the dutch deepens to -5 with the ship's list and releases to level at the apex. FOV squeezes monotonically 70->62 (slow vice, no breathing) so the deck feels smaller the higher we rise. Beats: first hull lurch (slow heavy sway 0.7 freq) + a deep groan at t~0.3, the submerge wash at 0.55, the keel shake at 0.62 retuned to a low-frequency roll (0.8) instead of a rattle. Player-anchored offsets — the same shot serves the start-event TILT and the finale arrival flyaround.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
